scope: Solved nonlinear U, objective native replay, separated spatial axes and complete actual Panda inputs with exact original failures

objective_replay.scope: Replay objective nonlinear contact loads through native linear elastic recovery.
objective_replay.limitations: Same-load native versus independent linear gates remain strict. Difference from objective nonlinear Cauchy stress is a linearization/geometry approximation diagnostic, not an algebra failure. Resolved forces remain unchanged apart from the explicit frame rotation; their deformed/reference moment difference is retained. One hold is not spatial/regularization/history convergence or actual Franka matching.

franka_strict_input_audit.scope: Audit captured rigid wrenches, temporal settling and complete finger geometry.
franka_strict_input_audit.limitations: Wrench moments are scaled by fixed20mm solely for rank/residual diagnostics. Unconstrained point-force span is an outer support test, not a friction-cone feasibility or global grasp impossibility claim. Contact birth, geometry/pose changes and finite contact moments can change support. No stationary frame is accepted from translational speed alone; angular motion, six-component equilibrium and temporal trends remain explicit. All12 finger geoms must be retained in corresponding references.

contact_axes.scope: Separate body and pad spatial changes on the four completed U references.
contact_axes.limitations: Two levels per separated axis diagnose the dominant spatial change; they do not establish a tail. Body mesh changes also approximate the continuum geometry, while pad refinement approximates its curved surface and contact integration. Linear body/part assumptions remain explicit and nonlinear references are separate physical-model checks. Whole raw peaks, original residuals and all fixed probes remain retained.

earlier_capture_limitations: Original rg-unavailable captures have incomplete engine/asset source lists; earlier2/4-substep geometry filenames overwrite within a macro step. Diagnostic v3 retains its failed geometry guards. These original attempts are preserved but are not accepted as complete matched inputs.
